title: Бывшая жена шефа и благотворительный вечер  (The Chef's Ex-Wife and the Charity Gala)

scenes.title: Denis Meets Katya's Mother
scenes.summary: Katya introduces Denis to her mother Eleonora Andreevna, and Denis realizes in horror that he slept with Katya's mother.

scenes.title: Barinov and Eleonora's Reunion
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov walks in and trades sharp barbs with his ex-wife Eleonora before learning she is the new owner of the hotel.

scenes.title: The Husband's Inheritance and the St. Petersburg Trip
scenes.summary: Eleonora explains her late husband left her the hotel; Barinov threatens to quit, and Eleonora asks Katya to cover an event in St. Petersburg.

scenes.title: The Fake Sick Leave and Kitchen Panic
scenes.summary: Eleonora orders Mikhail to tell the St. Petersburg chef to stay home, while Barinov tells his worried cooks who the hotel owner is.

scenes.title: Twenty Thousand Euros to Leave Town
scenes.summary: Eleonora offers Denis twenty thousand euros to disappear while Katya is in St. Petersburg, and fires him when he refuses.

scenes.title: Barinov's Contract Saves Denis
scenes.summary: When Barinov hears that Eleonora fired Denis, he marches up to her office and uses his contract with her late husband to reinstate him.

scenes.title: The Chef Stays and Katya Flies Out
scenes.summary: The kitchen celebrates Chef Barinov's decision to stay, and Katya says a warm goodbye to Denis before heading to the airport.

scenes.title: Denis Refuses Eleonora's Money
scenes.summary: Protected by Barinov, Denis returns to Eleonora's office to tell her he will never leave Katya.

scenes.title: The Order to Mikhail and Nagiyev's Arrival
scenes.summary: Eleonora orders Mikhail to get rid of Denis by any means, then briefs Dmitry Nagiyev on hosting her wildlife charity gala.

scenes.title: Nagiyev and Barinov's Banter
scenes.summary: Eleonora grants Nagiyev free stays in her luxury suite, and Nagiyev and Chef Barinov trade sharp jokes in the lobby.

scenes.title: The Breathalyzer Test and the Trap for Denis
scenes.summary: Mikhail runs a surprise breathalyzer check hoping to catch Denis, then has cleaner Gulya send Denis up to a guest suite.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Revenge and the Suite Trap
scenes.summary: Nagiyev blames Barinov for a cleaner using his suite bathroom and retaliates in Barinov's office while Mikhail sends Veronika upstairs.

scenes.title: The Missing Fur Seal and the Snake
scenes.summary: Right before the charity auction, Mikhail tells Eleonora that the fur seal and mink could not come, leaving only a rat snake.

scenes.title: Kidnapping Denis to Room 205
scenes.summary: Cleaners drug Denis with sleeping pills and carry him to room 205, but Gulya warns Kostya and Nastya to rescue him.

scenes.title: Fried Eel Instead of the Rat Snake
scenes.summary: When Nagiyev lifts the cover, the guests see a cooked dish instead of a live snake, and Eleonora angrily confronts Barinov.

scenes.title: The Snake's Escape from the Pot
scenes.summary: Barinov reveals he cooked an eel and hid the live snake in a pot—until they open the lid and discover the snake has escaped!

scenes.title: The Snake Bite and One Hundred Thousand Rubles
scenes.summary: The escaped snake bites Nagiyev on the backside, and he offers one hundred thousand rubles for someone to suck out the venom.

scenes.title: The Rat Snake Is Not Venomous at All
scenes.summary: Right after Fedya finishes 'saving' Nagiyev, Chef Barinov casually remarks that a rat snake is completely non-venomous.

scenes.title: Katya's Return and Searching for Denis
scenes.summary: Katya returns early from the airport, makes Eleonora promise not to fire her father, and learns Denis was taken to room 205.

scenes.title: Saving Denis and the New Arkady
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya smuggle Denis out of room 205 in time, Barinov gets his ninth pet fish Arkady, and Katya praises her father.
